## Every row in full

### FIN-01 — MoT in A.B..C — the measure of time

**Statement.** A MoT is one whole and a moment inside it is its elapsed fraction in Base-3600 A.B..C, 0.0000..0000 at the start and 3600.3600..3600 at completion, converting to Earth LTU (D · W · M33 · Q99 · Y365 · h · min · s) and back within one C; timestamps read YYYY.MM.DD_HH.MM..SS in CST standard and durations 0000.00.DD_HH.MM..SS.

### FIN-04 — Escrow releases $/min

**Statement.** From the deposit day and time the escrow releases amount ÷ (MoT × 1440) per minute, linearly, for the MoT; released money is visible at once and withdrawable only from 3 hours after the deposit; a withdrawal can never take more than is withdrawable and the balance never goes negative.

### FIN-05 — The record — append-only, chain-hashed, replayable

**Statement.** A person's transactions are an append-only ledger per login: every entry carries the hash of the entry before it, an id already on the record is never written twice, the record replays to any revision, and a changed amount breaks the chain where it was changed; revision control is on from the first line, the Drone-2525 way.

|---|---|
